li.label: asks nothing of the world
li.description: We have so little, and we expect no more. Anything is a gift.

li.label: asks little of the world
li.description: A full belly and a dry place to sleep. Not much more is asked of the world.

li.label: used to plain living
li.description: Life is plain and I am used to it.

li.label: wants a settled life
li.description: A settled age. I expect what settled people have.

li.label: wants to live well
li.description: In an age like this one, I expect to live well.

li.label: wants the best of everything
li.description: The world has so much. Anything less than the best is a disappointment.
